description.en: Qianwen console quota windows and subscription model catalog carried by the provider plugin.
description.zh: 由 Provider 插件提供千问控制台配额窗口与订阅模型目录。

description.en: Add the serving key and, optionally, a console cookie for quota refresh.
description.zh: 填写推理密钥，并可选补充用于刷新额度的控制台 Cookie。

help_text.en: Optional. Paste the login_qianwenai_ticket cookie from the Token Plan console to refresh Credits usage.
help_text.zh: 可选。从 Token Plan 控制台粘贴 login_qianwenai_ticket Cookie，用于刷新 Credits 用量。
